understanding still has 3 undigested unknowns: Whether existing recovery smoke fixtures can be extended cheaply or whether version-bump-smoke should carry the main proof.; Whether DONE finalization should be factored into a shared helper now or kept as a minimal done_recover call to avoid broader churn.; Whether worktree dependency absence requires local install or can use existing build paths after copying/symlinking dependencies.

missing_scope_check: scope-check.json is missing PLAN gate evidence. Start a story-level PLAN scope reviewer with `lattice dispatch --storyId=B-6914 --agentType=lattice-review-scope-plan`; dispatch output is not gate evidence, and the lattice-review-scope-plan / scope-plan reviewer must finish by calling `lattice scope_check_save`. The implementation/main agent must not self-sign this evidence or manually edit story metadata. Local CLI guidance is not remote completion and must not be presented as receipt verification or production/full completion.
